description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three different SimCSE models - Unsupervised SimCSE, Supervised SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE - across three evaluation metrics: Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, labeled with the names of the models, while the vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy / Correlation" with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to approximately 0.95, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Each model is associated with a group of three bars, colored beige, pink, and blue, representing Sentiment Accuracy, STS Correlation, and Paraphrase Accuracy, respectively. The bars for each metric are grouped together for each model, with the beige bar (Sentiment Accuracy) consistently being the shortest, the pink bar (STS Correlation) in the middle, and the blue bar (Paraphrase Accuracy) being the tallest. The values for Sentiment Accuracy range from approximately 0.55 to 0.8, for STS Correlation from about 0.55 to 0.85, and for Paraphrase Accuracy from around 0.75 to 0.95. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, but the groups are arranged in a specific order from left to right, corresponding to the model names. No bars are visually emphasized.
